review.gallery: Two developer map gallery assets and one native brochure scene. Shared interior and amenity artwork across the Elitz 2 and Elitz 3 brochures was excluded.
review.location: Brochure page 19 map and page 18 journeys were reviewed separately. Two independent listings corroborate the project vicinity. Danube’s generic Elitz directions link points to the first project and was not used as this phase’s pin.
review.floorPlans: All 14 individual original developer drawings from the Vyxlo mirror. Printed totals checked visually. The 11-page official archive spread contains the same 14 individual drawings, with two on each relevant spread.

unavailable: A verified entrance, standalone retail plans and signed unit-specific schedules were not established.
Danube website asset redistribution requires separate permission.
